{{Top|leg}}
The '''Houk Territories''' made up the residence of the [[Houk/Legends|Houk]] colonists from [[Lijuter]] residing on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Sriluur/Legends|Sriluur]]. They were located in the [[Lesser Cueva]] region to the north of the world, just thirty [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] north of the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] capital [[City/Legends|city]], [[Dnalvec]].

During the [[Houk–Weequay conflicts]], the territories were under constant martial law.
